InfoItems.Info: Fixture has pan and tilt locks
Initial version for fixture firmware v1.2.2B. Built by Kacper Pazdzior, LTT, Poland.
Initial version for fixture firmware v1.2.2B. Built by Kacper Pazdzior, LTT, Poland.

Physical values and MA 3D behaviour verified with real fixture. Pan and tilt ranges adjusted to real fixture. Custom off-center default value for framing shutters assembly rotation to align frames with fixture's body. Rotations speeds for gobos, gobo wheels, color wheel, and prism are done to approximate the real fixture. Strobing rotations are visualised with regular rotations. 4-facet linear prism of the fixture is visualised with 2 facet prism in for similar result in MA 3D. Implemented prism disengage in MA 3D when frost is used. Dimmer macros parameters are defined as beam effect macros in Beam feature for clarity, and better indication of their actual functionality. Several other minor adjustments to physical/visualisation values, speeds and ranges. Issue: In MA 3D frames visualisation is applied after prism, while in real fixture prism affects entire framed beam.
Physical values and MA 3D behaviour verified with real fixture., Uploaded to Fixture Share.
